issues.statement: Committed state, inventory, and final audit mix the noncanonical RuneForge path with the verified RavenForge root; the RuneForge directory does not exist.
The committed final audit records the same stale commit at both boundaries despite later evidence commits.
The committed final audit claims provenance evidence while finding 009 is NOT_STARTED.
The Phase A/B check parses report prose and does not exercise software.
The committed finding 001 audit maps the decode statistic to stat.messages-decoded; the current catalog authority is stat.message.incoming-decoded.unique.
The committed state separately records the forbidden stat.messages-decoded.unique identifier.
The committed state lists two package files while the live v2 directory contains 205 files.
The claimed v2 archive is absent from its recorded path.
The v2 package manifest contains 197 entries while the directory contains 205 files, and recorded sizes and hashes for modified files are stale.
The committed binding report contains no input hashes, comparisons, expected records, or actual records.
The prior audit configuration has no distinct Umbral Plaque and Nightthorn Tablet identity checks.
The committed topology configuration covers three of seven required assets.

Later v2 frame edits remain incomplete: Laurel has two rather than four sun nodes and no enamel group; Living Root lacks separate moss-patch and four-leaf-bud groups; Briar Court has two rather than four amethyst nodes.
The later Wild Fox group contains one path rather than two controlled botanical curls.
Four required background outputs are 60 to 62 byte placeholder files and cannot be production resources.
All four added Codex card PNG files are byte-identical, so they do not represent distinct module assets.
The supplemental result reports pass while explicitly leaving geometry, renderer, accessibility, platform, and binding validators outstanding.
